name: ProofDeck
tagline: Chat with AI to turn your template and source material into a polished deck
description: Create and switch between independent AI presentation tasks in a Codex-style workspace. Upload a PowerPoint template and PDF, Word, text, or Markdown sources, then describe the deck you need. ProofDeck reuses the template's slides, masters, layouts, fonts, colors, and fixed components; generates editable PowerPoint content; supports direct text formatting and focused AI edits; and exports a presentation you can keep working in.
